title: The Last Cipher Revisited
author: Lena Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
